{{Quote|But you're crazy if you think a few kilos of vanalloy and vat-grown flesh could ever replace my wife.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Barduun]] on a [[Leia biot|biot replica]] of Solo's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
'''Vanalloy''' was a type of [[Metal/Legends|metal]]. During the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] businessmen [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] operated [[Powerbody|powerbodies]] built from vanalloy. The Qreph brothers also used vanalloy [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]] in the bodies of [[biot]]s grown in their [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] at the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Base Prime]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], such the [[Nargon]]s and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] biot [[Dena Yus]].<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Vanalloy featured in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
